name: Schrödinger no Nekomoto-kun
original_name: シュレディンガーの猫本くん
source:
A storm is brewing after school. Since the school had been temporarily closed and the trains had stopped running, Inudou was left unable to return home.


He'd been killing time in the art studio when suddenly, the doppelgänger of one of his classmates spoke to him.

"Could you help me find my body?"

Determined to uncover the truth behind how the body was lost, the two of them set out to navigate the darkened school building...

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11302]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
放学后一场风暴正在酝酿。由于学校暂时关闭，火车也停止运行，犬斗无法回家。


他正在艺术工作室里消磨时间，突然，他的一位同学的分身对他说话了。

“你能帮我找到我的尸体吗？”

决心揭开尸体失踪的真相，两人出发在漆黑的校舍中穿梭……

[来自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11302]Novelgame[/url]]
